title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, guided by a depth picture
description: Like "FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, up to five pictures" (flux2-klein-9b-da-edit), but image 1 reaches the model only as its depth picture (Depth Anything V2 Small, the Depth pack this template offers to install), as the DA workflow's "Controlnet" does: it is a layout and pose guide, not a picture the model sees. Put the scene or pose you want to keep in image 1, and the people and things to show in images 2 to 5. Say so in the prompt ("Image 1 is a depth map: keep its layout ... Put the fox from image 2 ..."): the DA author notes its influence "highly depends on the prompt". A subject placed in image 1 comes out as a pale shape. Bypass the Depth Estimate node to send image 1 itself; use the plain edit template when you do not need depth.
